goal: Improve real TP=1 G11 packed-NVFP4 MoE latency versus flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.

source_state.status: reverted to stable source after experiments

worker_cluster_sweep.conclusion: No useful worker-cluster override found. GEMM2 workers=96 was only noise-level equal to default, while GEMM1 overrides were all slower than the current ~676us stage.

final_scatter_x16_experiment.idea: Change final scatter from 8 bf16 elements per thread to 16 bf16 elements per thread, reducing each token from 4 H-blocks to 2 H-blocks and reusing top-k metadata over more columns.
final_scatter_x16_experiment.conclusion: Correctness was not stable on the first run and the passing benchmark was slower than the existing oct-load scatter. The extra per-thread work/register pressure outweighed the lower block count.

recommended_next_steps: Do not use worker-cluster environment overrides for the current GEMM1/GEMM2 defaults.
Keep the final scatter oct-load implementation unless moving to a true GEMM2-finalize fusion.
Further single-stage micro-optimizations are unlikely to close the ~2x FlashInfer gap; focus on eliminating intermediate memory traffic or fixing a faster GEMM2 epilogue with full-output validation.
